component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.n = 0 m.total = 3000 m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.001 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onFire") end sub
sub onReady() m.timer.control = "start" end sub
' Strictly increasing writes, streamed so later batches are ready while earlier ones apply. sub onFire() for i = 1 to 200 if m.n >= m.total m.timer.control = "stop" print "SCENE SENT: n=" + m.total.toStr() + " last=" + m.n.toStr() return end if m.n++ m.task.request = m.n end for end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
